# Support Guidelines

Thank you for using the **Content Repurposing Platform**!

We want to make getting help as easy and streamlined as possible. Before reaching out, please check the following resources:

---

## 1. Documentation & Architecture
- **[English Documentation](README.md)** & **[راهنمای فارسی](README.fa.md)**: Full installation, environment variables, and Docker Compose deployment instructions.
- **[System Architecture](ARCHITECTURE.md)**: Deep dive into microservice topology, data flow, and worker responsibilities.
- **[YouTube Downloader Engine](docs/YOUTUBE_DOWNLOADER_ARCHITECTURE.md)**: Details on cookie handling, bot detection mitigation, and error recovery.
- **[n8n Webhook Integration Contract](n8n_backend_integration_contract.md)**: Detailed specifications for webhook payloads and AI generation stages.

---

## 2. Community & Discussions
If you have general questions, ideas, or need guidance on configuring services (such as ArvanCloud S3, VPS deployments, or n8n workflow customization):
- **[GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/Mahdi-Soleimani/content-repurposing/discussions)**: Best place for Q&A, ideas, and architecture discussions.

---

## 3. Reporting Issues
- **Bug Reports**: If you found a confirmed bug or unexpected error, please search existing issues first. If not found, open a [Bug Report](https://github.com/Mahdi-Soleimani/content-repurposing/issues/new?template=bug_report.md).
- **Feature Requests**: To suggest new platform downloaders, LLM providers, or UI features, open a [Feature Request](https://github.com/Mahdi-Soleimani/content-repurposing/issues/new?template=feature_request.md).

---

## 4. Security Reports
Please do **not** report security vulnerabilities via public GitHub issues. See our **[Security Policy](SECURITY.md)** for confidential disclosure instructions.

---
